messages.subject: Covariances between endogenous latent variables
parts:
I would just like to confirm this quickly:

If I specify a covariance between two latent endogenous variables:

latent_endogenous_factor1 ~~ latent_endogenous_factor2

Does lavaan automatically give me the covariance between the error terms / residuals?

Since covariances between endogenous variables themselves would not be allowed in SEM.

I would like to do this as I believe these two latent endogenous factors to have something in common (type of construct/measurement method), but I don't want to correlate all of their indicators' error terms.
Is this the correct way to go ahead?
